citations.quote: The final section of the chapter introduces principal component analysis, which is an empirical description of how rates move together across the curve
The risk that rates along the term structure move by different amounts is known as curve risk

Clearly, if one wishes to directly model this instantaneous forward rate, there is no liberty in selecting the drift of its process, as it is completely determined by the chosen volatility coefficient

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Principal Component Analysis on the historical covariance of cross-tenor yield changes extracts three orthogonal factors — level, slope, curvature — that explain the bulk of curve variance. The factor-mimicking-portfolio basis is the natural coordinate system for curve trades and a more parsimonious hedge target than the full key-rate vector.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Term-Structure Factor Models (PCA Decomposition)
